    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    t = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    t = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=t, src=x)
    # Compute the average over the pool window
    # Reshape to (C, H//p, p, W//p, p)
    t = t.reshape((C, H // p, p, W // p, p))
    # Sum over the last two dimensions
    s = nl.sum(t, axis=[3, 4], keepdims=True)
    # Flatten the sum to 2D with shape (C * (H//p), W//p)
    s_flat = nl.ndarray((C * (H // p), W // p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    for i in range(s.shape[0]):
        for j in range(s.shape[1]):
            s_flat[i * s.shape[1] + j] = s[i, j]
    # Multiply by 1/(p*p)
    m_flat = nl.ndarray((C * (H // p), W // p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=m_flat, data=s_flat, op0=nl.multiply, operand0=1.0 / (p * p))
    # Reshape back to original out_shape
    m = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    for i in range(out_shape[0]):
        for j in range(out_shape[1]):
            m[i, j] = m_flat[i * out_shape[1] + j]
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=m)
    return out

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    t = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=t, src=x)

    # Compute mean over the last two dimensions
    # Use tile-based reduction
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, p, p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
        for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
            t_view = t[:, h * p:(h + 1) * p, w * p:(w + 1) * p]

def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):

    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Reshape to (C, H//p, p, W//p, p)
    # Then take mean over the last two dimensions
    # We'll use tile-wise operations to achieve this

    # We'll use the tile's partition dimension (axis 0) for C
    # and use the affine_range to iterate over the pooling windows
    # We'll compute the mean for each window and store it in the output
    
    # Create a tile for the output
    out_tile = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Loop over the input tensor
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):

                # Store the result in the output tile

    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=out_tile)
